concept_name: Heavenly Mounts Descending as Invasive Species
ecological_definition: Invasive species: when an alien species enters a new ecosystem, lacking natural enemies and carrying a niche advantage (high-level magic treasures), it rapidly becomes a top predator and disrupts the local ecological balance
core_case: After the Green Ox Spirit (Taishang Laojun’s mount) and the Nine-Headed Lion (Taiyi the Salvation Sage’s mount) descended to earth, they had no rival in the Western Continent; local demons and humans alike became their prey

invasive_species_list.original_habitat: Tushita Palace · Taishang Laojun’s alchemy room
invasive_species_list.invasion_location: Golden Helmet Mountain · Golden Helmet Cave
invasive_species_list.ecological_niche: Top predator (the Diamond Bracelet treasure makes it invincible)
invasive_species_list.invasion_advantage: Carries the Diamond Bracelet · can seize any weapon · local species cannot resist
invasive_species_list.removal_method: Reclaimed in person by its owner (Taishang Laojun)
invasive_species_list.ecological_damage: Severe · the gods’ weapons were seized · local order paralyzed

invasive_species_list.original_habitat: Marvelous Rock Palace of the Eastern Pole · mount of Taiyi the Salvation Sage
invasive_species_list.invasion_advantage: A nine-headed lion · can swallow myriad living beings in one gulp · built a family-style invasion network
invasive_species_list.removal_method: Reclaimed in person by its owner (Taiyi the Salvation Sage)
invasive_species_list.ecological_damage: Severe · established a cross-generational family invasion network

invasive_species_list.ecological_niche: Top predator (can swallow 50,000 birds a day)
invasive_species_list.invasion_advantage: Deep connections (Tathagata’s uncle) + the Yin-Yang Two-Qi Vase · can hold myriad living beings
invasive_species_list.removal_method: Reclaimed in person by its owner (Tathagata)
invasive_species_list.ecological_damage: Devastating · the entire Lion-Camel Kingdom was eaten · it became a ridge of skeletons

invasive_species_list.ecological_niche: Top predator + political disguise (impersonated the king for 3 years)
invasive_species_list.removal_method: Reclaimed in person by its owner (Manjushri)
invasive_species_list.ecological_damage: Moderate · impersonated the king and disrupted the court · ate palace maids

invasive_species_list.ecological_niche: Large herbivorous destroyer (herbivorous yet highly destructive)
invasive_species_list.invasion_advantage: Huge body + a trunk that coils and kills + Samantabhadra’s backing
invasive_species_list.removal_method: Reclaimed in person by its owner (Samantabhadra)

invasive_species_list.original_habitat: South Sea Putuo · a goldfish from Guanyin’s lotus pond
invasive_species_list.ecological_niche: Aquatic top predator (demanded a boy and a girl)
invasive_species_list.invasion_advantage: Nine-petal bronze hammer + Guanyin’s backing + aquatic advantage
invasive_species_list.removal_method: Reclaimed by its owner (Guanyin) with a bamboo basket
invasive_species_list.ecological_damage: Localized · ate one boy and one girl each year

invasive_species_list.original_habitat: Celestial Court’s Twenty-Eight Mansions · Kui Wood Wolf
invasive_species_list.ecological_niche: Top predator + marital disguise (with Princess Baihuaxiu)
invasive_species_list.invasion_advantage: Celestial Court position + inner elixir + transformation
invasive_species_list.removal_method: Punished by its owner (the Jade Emperor) to tend the furnace in Tushita Palace
invasive_species_list.ecological_damage: Moderate · ate people + seized the princess

invasion_pattern_insights: All 7 major invasive species came from the Celestial Court / Spirit Mountain · without exception
100% invasion success rate · local species could not resist
Highly uniform removal: the owners descended to reclaim them in person · never extermination
Ecological damage correlates positively with invasion duration · the Great Peng’s 9 years caused the worst damage
Heavenly mounts descending to earth is essentially ‘institutional species invasion’ · not an isolated incident
The ‘niche advantage’ (magic treasures) of alien species is the key to invasion success

native_species_characteristics: No backing · lone operators (White Bone Demon / Spider Demon)
No high-level treasures · rely on their own spells
Easily preyed upon by the local predator (Wukong)
Removal: killed by Wukong · no survivors
invasive_species_characteristics: Backed · organized (mounts of the Celestial Court / Spirit Mountain)
Carry high-level treasures (Diamond Bracelet / Yin-Yang Two-Qi Vase / nine-petal bronze hammer)
No local predators · even the gods struggle against them
Removal: reclaimed by owners · ‘escorted back to their original units’
native_vs_invasive_comparison.survival_rate_invasive: 100% (all taken back by their owners · none killed)
